First - Az and Canyon wanted to get in the water in the hot tub and pool so Canyon dumped ball pit balls in the water and Az went inside. Among Us, the Movie is a collection of this game played by us...the Tannerites Family!

First - We played Among Us in real life in our house with the whole family! The rules are simple and the tasks are fun. We all played but only one of us is the imposter!

First - We played among us in our house! 

Then - We played in our backyard on the playground!

And then - We Played Among Us The Ohana Adventure's House In Real Life! We house swapped with The Ohana Adventure and played Among Us inside their house! They played Among us in our house too so go check their video out after this! Among Us In Our House with The Ohana Adventure:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCuDTc9ztKJbsI6yleL3W2Vg

Then - We played among us in real life! The rules are simple and the tasks are fun. We all played but only one of us is the imposter!

Finally - We Played Among Us In Real Life Jail! This time the Imposter sent the Crewmates to giant lego jail! The problem with this is, that they couldn't say who the Imposter was so it made it much easier for the Imposter to win!

Welcome to The TANNERITES!
We are a family of 9 (Mom, Dad, and 7 kids) who loves to experience the best of life through spontaneous adventures, being positive about life's difficulties, loving and serving others, and BEATING Cancer!

Here is how the online game works! Five to ten players are suitable for playing the game, with ten being the highest possible number. Players are divided into Imposters and Crewmates, and these roles are randomly assigned. Crewmates need to perform tasks or bust Imposters, while Imposters need to kill the Crewmates until there is an equal number of Crewmates and Imposters on the ship.

Imposters have the special ability to use “vents” in the game. They can travel through these vents, which add more stealth to their movement. Players can explore different levels of these ventilation systems in various maps.

A Sabotage activates a fatal emergency in the game, like a reactor meltdown or oxygen failure and Crewmates lose if they are unable to stop these. Two Crewmates need to split to stop them, which means another Crewmate will be alone and Imposters can freely kill them. This is a decent strategy for Imposters to win.

Crewmates need to be efficient in performing their tasks, and if they are able to perform all of these, the crew wins. The crew can trigger meetings to discuss and vote out the Imposters. They can either press the red button in the spawning room or hit the horn on the bottom right of a corpse. Communication becomes very important in these meetings.

Crewmates can effectively spot fellow crewmates by noticing “visual tasks” that only Crewmen can activate. Players can add this to their game from the settings.

Here is how the online game works! Five to ten players are suitable for playing the game, with ten being the highest possible number. Players are divided into Imposters and Crewmates, and these roles are randomly assigned. Crewmates need to perform tasks or bust Imposters, while Imposters need to kill the Crewmates until there is an equal number of Crewmates and Imposters on the ship.

Imposters have the special ability to use “vents” in the game. They can travel through these vents, which add more stealth to their movement. Players can explore different levels of these ventilation systems in various maps.

A Sabotage activates a fatal emergency in the game, like a reactor meltdown or oxygen failure and Crewmates lose if they are unable to stop these. Two Crewmates need to split to stop them, which means another Crewmate will be alone and Imposters can freely kill them. This is a decent strategy for Imposters to win.

Crewmates need to be efficient in performing their tasks, and if they are able to perform all of these, the crew wins. The crew can trigger meetings to discuss and vote out the Imposters. They can either press the red button in the spawning room or hit the horn on the bottom right of a corpse. Communication becomes very important in these meetings.

Crewmates can effectively spot fellow crewmates by noticing “visual tasks” that only Crewmen can activate. Players can add this to their game from the settings.

buXkVSdjmos.description:
We played among us in real life! The rules are simple and the tasks are fun. We all played but only one of us is the imposter!

Welcome to The TANNERITES!
We are a family of 9 (Mom, Dad, and 7 kids) who loves to experience the best of life through spontaneous adventures, being positive about life's difficulties, loving and serving others, and BEATING Cancer!

Here is how the online game works! Five to ten players are suitable for playing the game, with ten being the highest possible number. Players are divided into Imposters and Crewmates, and these roles are randomly assigned. Crewmates need to perform tasks or bust Imposters, while Imposters need to kill the Crewmates until there is an equal number of Crewmates and Imposters on the ship.

Imposters have the special ability to use “vents” in the game. They can travel through these vents, which add more stealth to their movement. Players can explore different levels of these ventilation systems in various maps.

A Sabotage activates a fatal emergency in the game, like a reactor meltdown or oxygen failure and Crewmates lose if they are unable to stop these. Two Crewmates need to split to stop them, which means another Crewmate will be alone and Imposters can freely kill them. This is a decent strategy for Imposters to win.

Crewmates need to be efficient in performing their tasks, and if they are able to perform all of these, the crew wins. The crew can trigger meetings to discuss and vote out the Imposters. They can either press the red button in the spawning room or hit the horn on the bottom right of a corpse. Communication becomes very important in these meetings.

Crewmates can effectively spot fellow crewmates by noticing “visual tasks” that only Crewmen can activate. Players can add this to their game from the settings.

jg2GiGKrbDI.description:
Allie and Daniell are in a MUSIC VIDEO!!
These kids are Warriors! There have been no updates in treatments for this type of cancer,  Osteosarcoma. Let’s all help them get the funds they need to research for more treatments! PLEASE donate if you can, but even if you can’t, just by sharing this video and using the #GoMakeItBetter, we have sponsors that will donate to the organization when the hashtag is used! So go have fun with this hashtag and you are literally making a difference for these kids!! 

This organization is 100% volunteers, so every penny directly to helping these kids:) So here it is:

1. Share this video with #GoMakeItBetter, and sponsors will donate to the organization every single time you use the hashtag!! So let’s spread this hashtag on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, snapchat, everywhere!!

2. If you want to go the extra mile, you can donate straight to “Make It Better Agents Organization” and let’s get enough funds to get updated treatments for these kids since the treatments haven’t been updated in 40 years!! You can donate here!:) https://donorbox.org/m-I-b-Agents.
